data.body: Phase 1 confirmed RCA (organic recurrence + runtime discrimination): the raw real-Git `tracker` fixture in tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py initializes a standalone repository and performs eleven ordinary Git writes without pinning `gc.autoDetach=false` and `maintenance.autoDetach=false`. Git 2.55 Trace2 captured every commit/merge spawning `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` (/tmp/rebar-authorship-trace2-1855.json; e.g. events 131, 205, 316, 391, 466, 599, 674, 749, 848, 923). The A/B arm with both knobs false changed those same runtime events to `--no-detach` (/tmp/rebar-authorship-trace2-foreground-1855.json). The organic Ubuntu 3.12 recurrence in run 32130591202/job 95691543683 then failed with missing reachable blob 66842fd, two packs, a MIDX, only five loose objects, and an empty tmp_pack_53R4Hl, although the fixture invokes no gc/repack/MIDX command. Repository-wide tracing found no path alias, cross-test delete, arbitrary Git-process reaper, global maintenance writer, or explicit collected-test MIDX path capable of reaching this tmp repository. This is the same detached-maintenance corruption mechanism already dynamically proven in ADR 0051 / bug amicable-unsure-barasinga (8/20 losses with detached maintenance versus 0/20 with both foreground pins); normal serial gc/repack was previously rejected as a cause. Changeable defect: fixture setup omits the two established foreground-maintenance pins, so ambient Git auto-maintenance escapes the synchronous fixture command and can race later writes/packing. Defect legitimacy: defect. The fixture is an exact real-history equivalence oracle and must deterministically preserve every reachable committed blob; ADR 0051 and src/rebar/_commands/init.py establish foreground maintenance as the repository invariant. Expected post-fix behavior: every Git auto-maintenance child caused by this fixture remains foreground; history topology and attribution assertions remain unchanged. Caller sweep: fixture-local setup only; no production caller behavior depends on detached upkeep. Phase 2 may proceed with a test-only restoration and no new dependency.
